base_issue.title: Build an n8n MVP governance gate

descriptions.canonical:
### User story

As the delivery owner, I want the saved contract and actual Git branch checked before implementation, so that invalid work is stopped.

### Required change

A read-only issue lookup → a deterministic contract and branch decision.

### Acceptance criteria

AC-1: A canonical story on its governed branch is allowed.

Verify with: Execute the canonical positive fixture and assert an empty violation-code list.

AC-2: Every invalid contract or runtime state is rejected.

Verify with: Execute each negative fixture and assert its exact violation codes.

Record every criterion as PASS, FAIL, or UNPROVEN. Agent statements are not proof.

### Non-goals

External writes and deployment.

### Execution constraints

Use the saved Linear issue and locally observed Git state.

### Deployment

in scope: localhost n8n Community Edition MVP

### Links

- [Canonical guide](https://linear.example/document/story-contract-v2)
